analysis: copy-minimizing fabrics on Experiment 14 Architecture D encoding
fairness: Frozen Experiment 9 weights. No Python output correction. A finite-A feedback TIA was tried on Architecture I and rejected: the summing node sits at V/A and breaks unbuffered divider math (MAE scaled as ~1/A). I therefore uses a 0 V summing node plus one current dump onto physical R_IV. copy_polarity on M is ignored (one gain cannot unbalance). copy_polarity on I unbalances the invert-pair R2. Not layout. Not foundry PCM.

D.title: Experiment 14 Architecture D (dual CCCS + buffered dividers)
D.copy_mechanism: Two unity CCCS conveyors form I+ minus I- onto physical R_IV. Unity VCVS buffers isolate divider taps.

I.title: current-mode invert-and-sum, unbuffered compensated dividers
I.copy_mechanism: Passive inverting amplifiers (R ratio) create -Vin. One 0 V summing node per neuron. One current dump onto physical R_IV. Fine taps load-compensated, no isolation buffer. No dual CCCS.

M.title: matched current subtractor on Architecture D fabric
M.copy_mechanism: Same resistors and divider buffers as D. One B-source I = i(V+) - i(V-) replaces the dual CCCS pair.

D.title: Experiment 14 Architecture D (dual CCCS + buffered dividers)
D.copy_mechanism: Two unity CCCS conveyors form I+ minus I- onto physical R_IV. Unity VCVS buffers isolate divider taps.

nominal.active_note: Counts are behavioral controlled sources, not transistors. leftover_copy_blocks = CCCS + matched subtractors + unity VCVS. Closed-loop op-amps set a resistor ratio and are listed separately.
nominal.energy_note: I_rel = SigmaG * 1 V is a relative signal-path metric. Not board power. Behavioral sources have no Iq.

current_cost.label: relative physical current cost
current_cost.note: I_rel = SigmaG * V_rep with V_rep=1 V. This is a relative conductance-derived metric, not measured board power. SPICE source current is the sum of |I| through Vin* and Vref at one representative operating point.

params.name: D_copy_common_0
params.note: copy_common scales the current-copy / subtractor (D/M) or the TIA open-loop gain (I). copy_polarity unbalances + vs - copies (D dual CCCS; I invert-pair R2; M has one subtractor). buf_gain scales leftover VCVS copies. invert_polarity is an I-only extra unbalance of the invert pair. tia_vos is TIA input offset. These are behavioral sources, not transistors.

M.title: matched current subtractor on Architecture D fabric
M.copy_mechanism: Same resistors and divider buffers as D. One B-source I = i(V+) - i(V-) replaces the dual CCCS pair.

nominal.active_note: Counts are behavioral controlled sources, not transistors. leftover_copy_blocks = CCCS + matched subtractors + unity VCVS. Closed-loop op-amps set a resistor ratio and are listed separately.
nominal.energy_note: I_rel = SigmaG * 1 V is a relative signal-path metric. Not board power. Behavioral sources have no Iq.

current_cost.label: relative physical current cost
current_cost.note: I_rel = SigmaG * V_rep with V_rep=1 V. This is a relative conductance-derived metric, not measured board power. SPICE source current is the sum of |I| through Vin* and Vref at one representative operating point.
